description: This file defines the ValidationException class used within the OpenMRS API to handle validation-related errors, particularly those involving Spring Errors objects.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling validation errors within the OpenMRS API, extending APIException and incorporating Spring Errors object.

methods.name: ValidationException()
methods.description: Default constructor, generally not recommended for use.

methods.name: ValidationException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a helpful message string.

methods.name: ValidationException(String message, Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a message and a cause for chaining exceptions.

methods.name: ValidationException(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that wraps a parent exception cause.

methods.name: ValidationException(Errors errors)
methods.description: Constructor that associates a Spring Errors object with the exception.

methods.name: ValidationException(String message, Errors errors)
methods.description: Constructor with a message and an Errors object.

methods.name: getErrors()
methods.description: Gets the Errors object associated with the validation failure.

methods.name: setErrors(Errors errors)
methods.description: Sets the Errors object associated with this exception.
